verdict.rationale: The client documents uploading directories to a data storage service, including as collections. Kosmos is described as working from a research objective plus one or more user-supplied datasets, and chat sessions keep workspace files across turns. No doc shows the Literature agent searching, citing or synthesizing over a user-uploaded PDF corpus rather than its built-in 175M-paper index, so research over your own PDFs is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that uploaded PDFs or collections can be attached to literature tasks, details on supported document formats, and hands-on or independent corroboration of research over a private corpus.
